messages:
Jordan (CSM): Quick heads-up — Lyra is ready to sign but procurement pushed NET60 and wants to split payment 50/50 between PO and CC. They also need our vendor code and a short SOW appendix for services. Any blockers?
Priya (AE): Thanks. They want to keep current pricing but shift term to 12mo with NET60. Asking if we can accept split payments.
Elena (Lyra): Hi team — yes, we can do 50/50 CC/PO if Redwood can accept NET60 on the PO side. Vendor code request attached.
Connor (Billing): NET60 is outside standard for self-serve. For enterprise we can do NET45/NET60 with approvals. Need: vendor code, tax ID, bill-to contact, and final PO format.
Procurement Bot: Policy: "Standard payment terms = NET30/NET45. NET60 requires Finance approval and signed SOW appendix."
Jordan (CSM): @Finance (esc) can you weigh in? Also tagging Legal Ops for SOW appendix language and signature path (PO vs e-sign).
Finance (esc): We can approve NET60 for this account if ARR >= commit threshold and there's a 50% upfront CC authorization captured. Need FP&A signoff — please pass estimated revenue schedule.
Priya (AE): Lyra commit is $180k ARR. They'll do 50% on CC at close, 50% on PO NET60. Suggest 9mo term as compromise to reduce exposure and prorate accordingly. Thoughts?
Legal Ops: We can add a short SOW appendix stating scope + acceptance criteria. Signature options: (1) e-sign via DocuSign on master + SOW, or (2) customer PO referencing our contract + countersigned PDF. Both ok but vendor code must be on invoice. If PO says "NET60" we need Finance approval email on the thread.
Elena (Lyra): DocuSign is preferred internally but procurement insisted on a PO for their records. They can attach the PO referencing the DocuSign contract.
Connor (Billing): If we take split flow, do this: capture 50% on CC at close -> issue invoice for remaining 50% with `PO: LYRA-2026-001` and NET60 terms. Need vendor code and remit-to. Example invoice header: `VendorCode: RWINF-42
TaxID: 12-3456789
PO: LYRA-2026-001`
Jordan (CSM): I'll request vendor code + confirm PO template from Elena. @Onboarding Eng please note: if they sign DocuSign we need kickoff date anchored to payment received for CC portion.
Onboarding Eng: noted. We'll start enablement once CC charge clears. If PO arrives first, we'll queue tasks but wait for CC confirmation for critical path.
Finance (esc): Marking tentative approval. Send revenue schedule and CC authorization screenshot to get final sign-off.
Jordan (CSM): Action items: (1) Jordan to collect vendor code + PO example from Lyra (2) Priya to propose 9mo prorate option and email procurement with our SOW appendix draft (3) Connor to prepare invoice template and payment capture link (4) Legal Ops to prepare short SOW appendix and sign-off matrix.
Priya (AE): I'll reach out to procurement right now and loop in FP&A.
Elena (Lyra): VendorCode=LYRA-V-77. PO will reference `Master Agreement v2` and include our contact. I'll send PO draft in ~2 business days.
Jordan (CSM): Great, thanks everyone. Please react here with :thumbsup: when you have the docs ready. I'll keep the thread updated with any procurement changes.
Connor (Billing): Will prep invoice and payment link, ETA EOD tomorrow.
Legal Ops: Drafting SOW appendix now, will share for review by EOD.
Priya (AE): Sent procurement note. Will update thread. :rocket:
Jordan (CSM): Closing loop for now — next update when PO or DocuSign arrives. Thanks all.
